title: Chainflip says attacker took BTC, ETH and stablecoins from its vaults; offers 10% bounty
date_note: Chainflip's message says the funds were taken on 21 November 2026; the time of day is The Block's, as relayed by CryptoTicker.
geo_basis: No page read states where Chainflip is based or where the affected systems are.
summary: Chainflip Labs said in a message to the attacker that on 21 November 2026 they took 122.86137042 BTC, 520.2243399 ETH, 3,249,631.41 USDC and 758,141.33 USDT from its vaults, and offered a 10% bounty. Its incident report says a further 10.48288011 BTC was taken afterwards, and that investigators believe the attacker exploited a memory-safety bug in a third-party networking library used by validator software; some steps are not yet fully confirmed.
plain: The crypto service Chainflip says an attacker took bitcoin, ether and stablecoins from its vaults on 21 November. It offers to let the attacker keep 10% if 90% is returned by 23 November.
exec: Chainflip says funds were taken from its vaults and that governance put the protocol into safe mode, per its incident report; investigators believe a third-party library bug was exploited.
impact: Funds taken from Chainflip vaults; swaps, deposits and withdrawals paused in safe mode according to Chainflip incident report.

sources.name: Chainflip: Incident Report: Bitcoin and Ethereum Vault Exploit (Part 1)
Chainflip Labs: Message from Chainflip Labs

evidence.quote: Keep 10% as a bounty and return 90%:
If both arrive by 18:38 UTC on 23 November 2026, we will treat this as a white hat recovery
According to The Block, the attack began on November 21 at around 2:10 a.m. Eastern Time, or about 8:10 a.m. German time.
10.48288011 BTC remaining in the vault, still accessible via the stolen key, was taken.

validation.note: Primary: Chainflip Labs' own message to the attacker (chainflip.io/return) states the amounts, bounty and deadline. CryptoTicker and Shattered independently report the drain and safe mode. Chainflip has published no post-mortem on its blog as read; total value in USD varies by outlet (about $12 million per Cointelegraph, relayed by CryptoTicker) and is left out.

key_findings: Funds taken from Chainflip vaults on 21 November 2026
Chainflip says it has identified the mechanism of key exposure and prevented such future attacks

review.note: stronger than the source: summary now says investigators believe the library bug was exploited; exec no longer cites outlets for key exposure, uses Chainflip report; source published days filled. Amounts, bounty, 10.48288011 BTC, time confirmed.
